scientific_integrity: A self-contained all-order gap proof and reproducible independent finite verifier accompany the claim. Historical novelty has residual literature-access risk.
scientific_limitations: The count is for minimum-size power dominating sets of cycle one-leaf coronas, not all inclusion-minimal sets or full power domination polynomials; the recent algorithmic preprint could only be compared at the abstract level; no independent mathematical review has occurred.
title: Minimum power dominating sets of sunlet graphs: an exact modulo-three census
